description: Features from the applicant's earlier applications to Home Credit, one row per applicant. Built in notebooks/05_previous_application_eda_features.ipynb.

not_used.installments_payments.csv, POS_CASH_bala: Out of scope for this table. All three pass the supply test (section 1.5) and are for later notebooks.
not_used.AMT_GOODS_PRICE: Equal to AMT_APPLICATION wherever both are present.

applicants_without_an_earlier_applicatio: PREV_N_APPLICATIONS is 0 and every other feature is missing.

PREV_N_APPLICATIONS.definition: Number of earlier applications to Home Credit after cleaning. 0 when there are none, in which case every other feature is missing.

PREV_N_CANCELED.definition: Earlier applications that were cancelled. Such records exist for about two years only, and most have nothing requested.

PREV_LAST_DECIDED_WAS_REFUSED.definition: 1 if the most recent decided application was refused, 0 if it was approved.

PREV_N_REFUSED_12M.definition: Refusals decided in the 365 days before the current application.

PREV_N_REFUSED_24M.definition: Refusals decided in the 730 days before.

PREV_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_REFUSAL.definition: Days from the most recent refusal to the current application.

PREV_N_REFUSED_OTHER.definition: Refusals with any other reason, or none recorded.

PREV_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_DECISION.definition: Days from the most recent earlier application to the current one.

PREV_DAYS_SINCE_FIRST_DECISION.definition: Days from the earliest recorded application to the current one. The history stops at eight years.
PREV_DAYS_SINCE_FIRST_DECISION.warning: Its distribution differs between train and test in fine detail, though not in ten coarse bands (stage 8, section 8.1).

PREV_HISTORY_REACHES_WINDOW_EDGE.definition: 1 if the earliest recorded application is at least seven years old, so the true length of the relationship is unknown.

PREV_N_DECIDED_12M.definition: Approved or refused applications in the last 365 days.

PREV_MEAN_DAYS_BETWEEN_DECISIONS.definition: Days between the earliest and the most recent application, divided by the number of gaps. Missing with one application.

PREV_HOUR_MEAN.definition: Average hour of day at which decided applications were made.

PREV_N_WALK_IN.definition: Decided applications of product type walk-in.

PREV_N_X_SELL.definition: Decided applications of product type x-sell (cross-sold).

PREV_N_CHANNEL_AP_CASH.definition: Decided applications made through the AP+ (Cash loan) channel.

PREV_N_CLIENT_TYPE_NEW.definition: Decided applications made when the applicant was recorded as a new client.

PREV_COST_OF_CREDIT_MEAN.definition: Average over approved loans with a fixed term of total repayable (annuity x number of payments) divided by the amount granted.

PREV_COST_OF_CREDIT_LAST.definition: The ratio for the most recent approved loan that has one.
PREV_COST_OF_CREDIT_LAST.warning: Its distribution differs between train and test in fine detail, though not in ten coarse bands (stage 8, section 8.1).

PREV_RATE_PER_PAYMENT_MEAN.definition: Average over approved loans of (cost of credit - 1) divided by the number of payments: a rough rate that does not grow with the term.

PREV_YIELD_LEVEL_MEAN.definition: Average yield group of approved loans on a scale of low_action 0, low_normal 1, middle 2, high 3.

PREV_YIELD_LEVEL_LAST.definition: Yield level of the most recent approved loan that has one.

PREV_N_APPROVED_HIGH_YIELD.definition: Approved loans in the high yield group.

PREV_AMT_CREDIT_MEAN.definition: Average amount granted on approved applications.

PREV_GRANTED_TO_REQUESTED_MEAN.definition: Average of amount granted divided by amount requested, over approved applications.

PREV_DOWN_PAYMENT_RATE_MEAN.definition: Average down payment rate of approved applications that have one (consumer loans).

PREV_N_LOANS_ENDED.definition: Approved loans with a termination date recorded.

PREV_N_LOANS_RUNNING.definition: Approved loans with no termination recorded at the current application.

PREV_RUNNING_ANNUITY_SUM.definition: Total annuity of loans still running: what the applicant already pays Home Credit each month.

PREV_RUNNING_MAX_DAYS_REMAINING.definition: Longest time to the planned last payment among loans still running.
PREV_RUNNING_MAX_DAYS_REMAINING.warning: Differs between train and test (stage 8, rule 1): keep with a warning: the values differ between the files, not how often the column is filled in. Report the model with and without it.

PREV_N_UNUSED_OFFER.definition: Earlier applications approved and not taken up.

PREV_SHARE_REFUSED.definition: Refused applications as a share of decided ones (approved or refused).

PREV_SHARE_REFUSED_24M.definition: Refusals as a share of decided applications, over the last 730 days.

PREV_DAYS_SINCE_LAST_APPROVAL.definition: Days from the most recent approval to the current application.

PREV_N_APPROVED_12M.definition: Approved applications in the last 365 days.

PREV_SHARE_APPROVED_CASH.definition: Approved cash loans as a share of approved applications.

PREV_SHARE_WALK_IN.definition: Walk-in applications as a share of decided ones.

PREV_N_LOANS_ENDED_EARLY.definition: Ended loans whose last payment date was more than 30 days before the planned one.

PREV_RUNNING_CREDIT_SUM.definition: Total amount granted on loans still running.

most_recent_rule: The latest DAYS_DECISION, with ties on the same day broken by the higher SK_ID_PREV.
properties_verified: Each applicant's features depend on that applicant's rows only (section 7.4).
No function uses the target, and none contains a number estimated from the data.
An independent rebuild of 2,598 applicants from the raw rows agrees on all 53 features (section 7.2).
The current application is not in the table, and nothing is dated on or after it apart from planned end dates (stage 4).
Every column passes the train-test supply test (section 3.3).
selection_note: Five features were dropped using development-set outcomes and one was added (RATE_PER_PAYMENT_MEAN). The holdout was not used.
